text:
Bitcoin remained suppressed in the $62,600–$62,700 band midday on June 24, grappling with a deeply bearish "Extreme Fear" sentiment reading of 17. The digital asset ecosystem continues to weather a staggering $8 billion in 30-day institutional ETF outflows, which has contracted global crypto ETP assets under management to $140 billion. Despite this sustained selling pressure, on-chain data suggests sophisticated allocators are bypassing ETFs to accumulate via direct custody.

Concurrently, institutional regulatory guardrails are hardening. As the European Union races toward its July 1 MiCA deadline, U.S. regulators at FinCEN are actively drafting new Bank Secrecy Act verification rules to classify stablecoin issuers as financial institutions under the pending GENIUS Act.

This crypto hesitation directly mirrors a cautious traditional macro environment. With the 10-year Treasury yield stabilizing at 4.48% and softening oil prices easing headline inflation fears, liquidity remains sidelined ahead of tomorrow's highly anticipated U.S. PCE inflation print.
